name: Sakura Sky Archipelago
description: Islands of cherry blossom trees floating in a perpetual spring sky, petals forming pink clouds below, connected by bridges of woven falling blossoms that never reach the ground.
prompt: Floating archipelago of cherry blossom islands in eternal spring sky, trees in full bloom creating pink petal clouds below, bridges of woven falling blossoms suspended mid-air, soft pink and white palette, petals glowing with inner light, dreamlike atmospheric perspective, Japanese aesthetic, 8k, ukiyo-e meets 3d render
caption: Spring refused to leave. So it learned to fly. 🌸☁️
